title: Monday Quick Tip
subtitle: Talk first or show first
hook: Do you explain the drill first or show it first?
intro: Then you show it, and kids realize what you meant.
statement: The order you teach in changes what kids remember.
q1: Do you show the drill first and explain after —
q2: or explain first so they know what to watch for?
q3: When did kids get it, during the talk or the demo?
t1: Every coach is different. But kids catch on faster
t2: when they see it before they hear it.
ctaLines: Show, then one point. Talk, then show. Just start.
ctaPrompt: Share your teaching habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Do you explain the drill first or show it first?
You talk through the drill. Then you show it, and kids realize what you meant.
The order you teach in changes what kids remember.
Show first or explain first. Every team is different.
Show or tell first? Share your habit in the comments.
